Loads Solana key files into protected memory pages and clears them on unload.

# Purpose
This file implements key file loading for validator identity material. It reads a Solana-style JSON array of 64 decimal byte values from a file, parses the values into a 64-byte keypair buffer, and reports parse or I/O errors with detailed log messages. The main entry point, [`fd_keyload_load`](<#fd_keyload_load>), opens the key file, allocates protected memory for the key, loads the key bytes, and can return only the public key when `public_key_only` is set.

The file also defines the memory handling used for sensitive key data. [`fd_keyload_alloc_protected_pages`](<#fd_keyload_alloc_protected_pages>) allocates pages with guard pages on both sides, locks the key page in memory, and marks it to avoid core dumps and fork inheritance. [`fd_keyload_unload`](<#fd_keyload_unload>) clears the key page and releases the mapped memory. These functions are used to keep private key material in protected memory while it is in use.
